Drawn as if 64x64 pixels upscaled with nearest neighbour. No text, no border, no watermark, single subject. Subject: a Y-shaped crystalline antibody drone, ice-white with cyan tips on its two upper arms and a glowing gold binding site at the fork; small and floating, about half the frame.
